entityName: Thessaloniki Water Supply and Sewerage Co, SA
entityDescription:
Thessaloniki Water Supply and Sewerage Co, SA (EYATH S.A.), a company listed on the Athens Stock Exchange since 2001, provides water supply and sewerage services to more than 1.2 million citizens in the greater Thessaloniki Urban Area every day. It specialises in the design, construction, installation, operation, utilisation, management, maintenance, extension and renewal of water supply and sewerage systems. Its activities include projects such as desalination, pumping, treatment, storage, transport, distribution and management of all types of water, as well as the collection, transport, treatment, storage and management of waste (other than toxic).
Moreover, the company undertakes the utilisation of products from waste water treatment, the provision of telecom services via the water supply and sewerage networks it operates and is also involved in the generation and sale of own-produced electricity (which is primarily generated by utilising water from springs, dams, aqueducts and pipelines). The EYATH’s competencies also include extensions to new areas or changes to water supply-sewerage systems (networks and facilities), to improve the quality and quantity of water supplied to consumers.

description:
Cloud&Heat Technologies is a cloud service and technology provider based in Dresden, with a focus on open infrastructures, digital sovereignty, and energy efficiency. The company develops and operates holistic, open, and sustainable digital infrastructures built on proven open-source technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes, and Proxmox.
Cloud&Heat offers both cloud services and on-premises cloud infrastructures, enabling flexible, digitally sovereign IT solutions—either in the cloud or directly on the customer’s sites. At the same time, the company pursues the vision of combining the growing demand for computing power—for instance in areas like deep learning and machine learning—with ecological responsibility, thereby improving the climate footprint across sectors.

SENSORBITE develops ageospatial intelligence platformthat integrates geospatial data to generate detailed, intuitive maps and reports. By employing advanced algorithms and AI-driven analytics, the platformtransforms complex remote sensing data into clear, actionable insightsthat simplify decision-making.
Users can interact with SENSORBITE usingplain language queries, enabling them to quickly access information on crop health, environmental changes, water usage, and other critical parameters. The system updates with the latest data, ensuring that its outputs remain both relevant and precise. Using a user-friendly interface,allows users to easily extract needed information, eliminating the need for specialized technical expertise.
Designed for a wide range of applications,SENSORBITE simplifies the monitoring of Earth’s dynamic processes, empowering stakeholders to make informed decisions and optimize resource management for sustainable outcomes. This approach to geospatial analysis enhances the proper use of Earth Observation in agriculture, forestry, environmental protection and sustainable urban planning.

The company conducts scientific and industrial research in geographic data localization, computer vision, and AI-driven interpretation of satellite imagery.

Satellite and aerial remote sensing data analysis

GIS and spatial data management

AI and computer vision for geospatial intelligence

R&D of software and hardware prototypes for monitoring systems

Applied research projects in natural sciences and engineering

entityDescription:
The Astronomical Society of Malta (ASM) is a non-profit Voluntary Organisation dedicated to promoting and advancing astronomy in Malta. The Society traces its roots back to 1976 when two distinct groups, the Malta Astronomical Association (founded in 1977) and the Students Astronomical Circle (founded in 1976), came together to form a unified organisation in 1984.The Astronomical Society has been at the forefront of fostering interest in astronomy and space sciences among the Maltese population.

The primary objective of the ASM is to spread knowledge about astronomy through public outreach, educational programs, and various events. They organise regular public stargazing sessions, where members of the public, regardless of age or background, can observe celestial objects through telescopes and learn about the wonders of the night sky from experienced astronomers.

description: Light Bridges (LB) is a pioneering Spanish R&D company, establishing itself as a leader in specialized scientific infrastructures for advanced astronomy and satellite tracking. LB designs, builds, and manages private scientific facilities that enable top international research groups to conduct high-impact research in astronomy, satellite tracking, and optical communications. Core Infrastructure LB’s flagship infrastructure, the Two-meter Twin Telescope (TTT), is located at the Teide Observatory and achieved First Light on December 5, 2022. Under the leadership of Economist Dr. Antonio Maudes and Astronomy PI Dr. Miquel Serra-Ricart, the TTT leverages cutting-edge technology, including robotic professional telescopes, high-performance GPUs and advanced data storage solutions, to push the limits of astronomical and space research. The TTT provides a highly automated, robust platform optimized for precise and rapid observations. Business Lines LB operates three core business areas, each designed to harness the full potential of its specialized infrastructure: Astronomy Research Projects. The TTT enables pioneering observations of astronomical phenomena, such as exoplanets, asteroids, and transient events. Through these capabilities, researchers gain unprecedented insights into the universe with high precision and depth, utilizing LB’s extensive image processing power. Satellite Tracking and Space Situational Awareness. LB applies its expertise in robotic telescope systems to satellite tracking, addressing the growing need for accurate space situational awareness. This service is critical for monitoring satellite orbits, managing collision risks, and providing data for secure, efficient satellite operations. Optical Communications Research. LB is at the forefront of developing ground-based infrastructure for classical and quantum optical communications. The TTT is strategically positioned to serve as a future ground segment for these advanced systems, reinforcing LB's role in supporting secure, high-capacity data transmission technologies. Supporting Scientific Talent. In collaboration with Spanish ICEX, LB manages the Light Bridges Fellowship program, which nurtures emerging talent in astronomy. This program allows fellows to work on international projects using LB’s high-performance data processing infrastructure, fostering innovation and expanding LB's research network globally. LB fosters global collaborations, ensuring that its state-of-the-art facilities remain at the forefront of scientific advancement.

entityDescription:
Pollux Tech IKE is a Greek deep-tech startup developing space-enabled technologies for maritime safety applications. The company focuses on human-centric solutions designed to enhance situational awareness and response effectiveness in safety-critical maritime scenarios.
Its core development activity concerns a wearable safety device concept intended for use by individuals operating in maritime environments. The system combines satellite connectivity, positioning capabilities, and embedded sensing to support timely detection and localisation in emergency situations. The solution is designed to operate autonomously and to integrate with existing maritime safety and search-and-rescue ecosystems.
Pollux Tech’s technology approach is complementary to established maritime safety infrastructures and follows a certification-aligned development pathway. The architecture is designed with scalability, interoperability, and future adaptability in mind, leveraging commercial satellite networks and standard positioning technologies.
The company targets professional maritime use cases and operates at the intersection of maritime safety, satellite communications, and applied space technologies, with ongoing activities focused on prototype development, testing, and validation within an innovation incubation framework.

description:
At Revolv Space, we unlock the full potential of small satellites by designing, manufacturing, and testing next-generation mechanisms and power systems that ensure uninterrupted payload availability and maximize the monetization of space assets.

Operating from Torino (Italy) and Delft (The Netherlands), we offer a family of affordable, high-performance Solar Array Drive Assemblies (SADAs) designed specifically for small satellites, supporting power ranges from 100W to 5kW. With its innovative redundancy systems and advanced sun-tracking technology, our SADAs optimize solar array exposure, doubling power generation compared to fixed arrays and vastly boosting smallsat platform capabilities and mission returns.

Our power generation systems are tailored to diverse small satellite missions, from Earth observation to communication and scientific research. As an agile alternative to established suppliers, we specialize in delivering reliable and cost-effective solutions with low-lead times, addressing urgent industry needs and aligning with the business models of large constellations.
